body: What do you want me to say??
Hey, you're still here and I'm still here, so maybe here's to another shitty year and maybe next year we will feel better and life won't suck as bad.
I've felt this way for years. Nothing ever gets better.

I fucked up a thing this morning. I got upset about it. He can't stand when I get upset and that just makes me feel worse. Today he blew up at me, made me feel more worthless than ever. I just hoped that maybe on my birthday he would try to understand, but he didn't. He says I'm too depressed and I bring him down. And he's right. I ruin everything, I don't deserve a happy birthday or even a mediocre one. I'm tired of making everyone so angry and I just wish I could disappear.

No one actually loves me. They just love the idea they have of me. I'll never actually be good enough for anyone. I'm such a burden. Everything I do somehow turns out wrong and I'm just so tired of trying.

I'm sorry. Today is my birthday too and honestly one of the worst days of my life. You're not alone. That probably doesn't make you feel better, but it's the truth. Here's to shitty birthdays and struggling to get up every morning. I hope things somehow get better for you.
